description:
We can never foresee the future and what it may possibly get us into. Even just a thought of the worst got me so anxious. But one of the best ways to be "panatag" is to get a life insurance, so I just did! Let's be practical. 😉

Sharing to you guys how easy and convenient I purchased my insurance online with FWD Insurance KanDuu Plans and it's sulit for Php1,799 per year. 

Here are the KanDuu plans I mentioned in the video:

KanMend
▪ Protection against 42 critical illnesses
▪ Reward: 6 months’ unli KonsultaMD telemedicine

KanLive
▪ Essential funds and protection for your family
▪ Reward: 1 year unli medical consults at Aventus clinics

KanGuard
▪ Payout for accidents or terror attacks, worldwide
▪ Reward: 1 year global emergency services

Visit their website to know more about FWD Insurance and scrutinize the Kanduu Plans that will best suit your lifestyle.  

FWD Life Philippines
https://www.fwd.com.ph/en/?utm_source=ShopFWD%20Unboxing%20-%20Davao&utm_medium=Various&utm_campaign=Influencers&utm_content=Omnibus

Shop@FWD

#ShopFWD #YouKanDuuItWithFwd

Have a great day! 

Love lots, Mai ♥
